reason: I already decided to go into the new country and I have no pipeline there, so the free 15-company list costs me nothing to look at. If the list and the local-language message are actually good, EUR 1,600 with a money-back guarantee is less than one trade-fair stand, so I would run the pilot in relationship mode.
objection: My name is on every message, and in our niche everyone knows everyone. One clumsy or pushy message to the wrong buyer and I lose a door I can't reopen, plus I'm not sure one logistics client with 45 meetings proves anything for a wholesaler like me.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies in the free step are ones I already know or obviously wrong for us, I walk away and don't pay.
